module GenericFunctionUnwrapBox

type Box<T> is record
    item: T
end record

function unwrap<T>(box: Box<T>) returns T
is
    return box.item
end unwrap

procedure main()
is
    let b: Box<Integer> = Box<Integer> { item: 1 }
    let x: Integer = unwrap<Integer>(b)
    check x = 1
end main

end GenericFunctionUnwrapBox
